title: Kona Blue documents admit capability to implant false memories

tellings.quote: In those documents, the United States government is admitting they have the capability to give you false memories, mess with your brain, make you do things, and that's without drugs.

plain: A guest named Dylan Borland, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, talks about a set of government papers known as the Kona Blue documents. Borland says that in those papers the United States government admits it can give people false memories, mess with their brains and make them do things, all without drugs. If true, it would mean the government holds a hidden power to reshape what people remember.
